name: PredictionCard
texts: Add a decoupling capacitor near U3Missing Component92%The ATmega328P at U3 has no 100 nF decoupling capacitor within 5 mm of its VCC pin. Place a 0.1 µF X7R cap between VCC and GND to suppress switching noise.MoreApply

Current-limit resistor missing on D1Safety78%LED D1 connects directly between GPIO13 and GND with no series resistor. At 5 V this exceeds the forward current rating. Add a 330 Ω resistor in series.MoreApply

texts: Design Suggestions3Add a decoupling capacitor near U3Missing Component92%The ATmega328P at U3 has no 100 nF cap within 5 mm of its VCC pin.
